build_argparse_options_parser: build an argparse parser with basic experiment parameters like name, checkpoint_dir, and model_path
create_reader_options: create command-line arguments for a reader model including train_data, eval_data, and text_maxlength
create_retriever_options: create command-line arguments for a retriever model including indexing_dimension, question_maxlength, and passage_maxlength
create_optim_options: create command-line arguments for optimizer settings including learning rate, dropout, weight_decay, and scheduler
parse_options_with_get_options: parse CLI arguments using get_options with optional reader, retriever, optim, and eval flags
